sources.title: Ripple and Coinbase Partner to Expand Access to Ripple USD
Ripple Offers Clients Access to Coinbase Derivatives Contracts Cleared by Nodal Clear
About U.S. Derivatives on Coinbase Prime

details: RLUSD trade and management available for retail and institutional clients
1:1 conversion from USD and other supported USD-denominated stablecoins into RLUSD
deposits and withdrawals supported across XRPL, Base and Ethereum
future_or_not_live: RLUSD collateral availability for Coinbase Global Exchange customers is stated as a future rollout, not live as of the announcement.

details: Ripple Prime clients receive access to the full suite of Coinbase Derivatives contracts through Hidden Road Partners CIV US LLC, now known as Ripple Prime.
The suite includes XRP futures and other crypto/commodity contracts.
Ripple became a clearing member of Nodal Clear.

infrastructure_relationships.from: Hidden Road Partners CIV US LLC / Ripple Prime

business_stack: Coinbase Prime institutional execution and custody
proposed Coinbase National Trust Company charter
coinbase_current_position.stablecoin_position: Coinbase distributes USDC through its established Circle relationship and now also distributes RLUSD through a direct Ripple partnership. This supports a multi-stablecoin distribution strategy; no exclusivity or stablecoin preference is established.
coinbase_current_position.derivatives_position: Coinbase operates the exchange and FCM channels while Nodal Clear is the central counterparty. Ripple Prime is a clearing member and distribution path for Coinbase Derivatives contracts.
coinbase_current_position.current_us_derivatives_collateral: Coinbase's current U.S. derivatives documentation lists USD and USDC auto-conversion for margin; it does not list RLUSD as current U.S. derivatives collateral.
coinbase_current_position.separate_charter_entity: Coinbase National Trust Company is a separate proposed trust-bank entity. Its OCC CAS record showed Approved on 2026-04-02 with no Consummated/Effective date in the retrieved record.

circle_relationship_context.established_relationship: Coinbase's long-standing USDC distribution and economics relationship with Circle remains separate from the new Ripple RLUSD partnership.
circle_relationship_context.competitive_implication: Coinbase can distribute both USDC and RLUSD, positioning itself as a multi-stablecoin access venue. The existence of both partnerships does not establish that Coinbase is shifting volume or economics away from Circle.
unknowns: RLUSD trading volume on Coinbase by chain
USDC versus RLUSD share of Coinbase stablecoin balances and revenue
Whether RLUSD collateral is enabled for Global Exchange and when
Any revenue-sharing terms between Ripple and Coinbase
Whether Coinbase's direct RLUSD distribution increases XRP spot demand

confirmed: Coinbase offers XRP futures through its derivatives exchange.
Ripple Prime clients can access Coinbase Derivatives contracts, including XRP futures, through Nodal Clear.
RLUSD can be deposited and withdrawn on XRPL through Coinbase's announced integration.
not_established: Any direct XRP spot purchase by Coinbase under the RLUSD partnership
XRP collateral use for the new RLUSD integration
RLUSD being accepted as collateral for Coinbase U.S. derivatives
XRP futures volume attributable to Ripple Prime clients
Net long/short exposure or spot hedging associated with the partnership
xrp_specific_interpretation.critical_distinction: The RLUSD distribution relationship and the XRP futures access relationship are separate channels. RLUSD is the stablecoin asset; XRP is the native XRPL asset and a separately listed futures underlying. Do not infer that RLUSD distribution creates equivalent spot XRP demand.

confirmed_fact: Ripple and Coinbase announced a direct RLUSD distribution partnership on 2026-10-28.
Coinbase Prime, Exchange and Retail support RLUSD from the announcement date.
Ripple Prime clients can access Coinbase Derivatives contracts through Nodal Clear under the 2026-03-05 announcement.
Nodal Clear's directory lists both Coinbase Financial Markets and Hidden Road Partners CIV US LLC as clearing members.
inference: Coinbase is positioning as a multi-stablecoin distribution, custody and derivatives platform rather than an exclusive distributor for one issuer.
The Ripple-Coinbase relationship is both competitive and cooperative: Ripple competes in stablecoins while relying on Coinbase for distribution and derivatives access.
speculation: The new RLUSD listing may create additional Coinbase stablecoin volume or revenue; realized volume and economics are not yet disclosed.
unknown: Actual RLUSD volume, balances, collateral use and revenue share
Actual XRP futures volume attributable to Ripple Prime clients
Whether RLUSD will become eligible collateral on Coinbase Global Exchange and actual usage after launch
Whether Coinbase's stablecoin revenue mix changes after RLUSD listing

next_actions: Track Coinbase RLUSD spot volume, balances, chain split and custody flows after launch.
Check Coinbase Global Exchange for actual RLUSD collateral activation; do not treat the announced future rollout as live.
Track Coinbase Derivatives XRP futures open interest, volume, basis and margin changes; compare with Ripple Prime client access only when client-level or clearing data are public.
Monitor Circle USDC economics and Coinbase revenue disclosures to assess multi-stablecoin distribution rather than assuming displacement.
Update the network graph with BNY custody, C2FO Instant Pay, and OCC trust-bank status as separate relationships.
